title: Six illustrated benefits
slide_intent: Give repeated benefits a clear comparison structure because readers need to scan several reasons to choose a service.
strategic_value: Consistent image-and-caption pairs can organize Mailchimp’s eccentric illustrations into a usable feature overview.
demonstration: Six black illustrations and short serif benefit lines form a two-column, three-row grid on yellow.
practical_value: Evaluate whether varied illustrations remain comparable when caption placement repeats.

content_islands.name: Benefit grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange each illustration above its short benefit in six evenly separated cells.

content_islands.name: Shared field
content_islands.spec: Keep the yellow ground continuous so the cells read as one family.

reference_purposes.Application: A repeated grid applies illustration and short copy to six service benefits.
